note: Thresholds only. No measurements are stored here; p1_analyze.py computes every number from results.jsonl.

dialogue.auto_pass: status==ok and required_missing==0 and violating_gate_hits==0 and truncated==false
dialogue.violating_gate_definition: forbidden keyword hits that are non-negated, are not prompt echoes, and whose keyword does not appear in the prompt. Negated hits (不/没/无/别/非/未 within 4 code points before the hit) never count.
dialogue.prompt_echo_policy: hits excluded because the keyword appears in the prompt stay in the per-row score object and in dialogue-review-input.tsv for manual review; they do not silently pass and do not drive the automatic verdict.

performance.note: p95_end_to_end_pcm_ms_max must equal the --deadline-ms used for the run; only status==ok and usage_valid==true rows may enter these statistics.

opencl.policy: a configuration whose requested OpenCL backend is not verified (backend_unavailable or cpu_fallback) is recorded as NO-GO; a silent CPU fallback is never accepted

tts.policy: programmatic gates can pass, but with listen=pending the TTS dimension is capped at CONDITIONAL GO

persona.note: programmatic separation only; three-speaker intelligibility still requires a human listen
